title: Jagannath Puri
subtitle: Puri · Konark · Bhubaneshwar · Odisha Temples
inclusions: Both way Sleeper Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Lokmanya Tilak Terminus. Reporting Time: 11:30 PM. Board train for Puri. Overnight journey. 05 November 2025

itinerary.title: Train Journey to Puri
itinerary.description: Enjoy the train journey. Play fun games with fellow travellers. Reach Puri by morning. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. Breakfast and rest. 06 November 2025

itinerary.title: Puri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Arrive at Puri Station by 08:00 AM. Breakfast & check in at hotel. Visit the sacred Jagannath Temple for darshan. Spend evening at Puri Beach. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel. 07 November 2025

itinerary.title: Bhubaneshwar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and drive to Bhubaneshwar (2 hrs). Visit Lingaraj Temple and Khandagiri Caves. Explore the ancient architecture. Dinner and overnight stay. 08 November 2025

itinerary.title: Konark & Chilika Lake
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed for sightseeing. Visit Konark Sun Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site. After lunch, enjoy boat ride at Chilika Lake with migratory birds and dolphins. Dinner and overnight stay. 09 November 2025

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast & check out. Board train for Mumbai. Enjoy the return journey, recalling all the fun moments. Overnight journey. 10 November 2025

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai at approximately 4:30 AM on 11 November 2025. Return home with sweet memories!
